metadata.question: Was the aerosol optical depth higher over the Takalaman Desert in February 2020 than in February 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search strategy**: - Use MODIS or Sentinel-5P data for aerosol optical depth (AOD). - MODIS has MCD19A2 (daily AOD) or MOD04_L2 (Collection 6). - Sentinel-5P has tropospheric_aerosol_optical_depth_550_nm. - Location: Taklimakan Desert (likely meant "Takalaman" → Taklimakan in China, ~39°N, 87°E). - Compare February 2020 vs February 2019. 2. **Masking strategy**: - AOD data comes pre-processed with quality flags. - Filter by quality assurance flags to ensure valid retrievals. - No cloud masking needed; just QA filtering. 3. **Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null**: - If AOD mean is a valid number (0–2 range), it's valid. - If result is NaN, None, or pixel count is 0, flag C2 or C3. - Compare 2020 vs 2019: if 2020_AOD > 2019_AOD → A, else → B. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Taklimakan Desert region const desert = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([82.5, 37.5, 91.5, 41.5]); // February 2020 const col2020 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD19A2_GRANULES') .filterDate('2020-02-01', '2020-02-29') .filterBounds(desert) .select('Optical_Depth_047'); // February 2019 const col2019 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD19A2_GRANULES') .filterDate('2019-02-01', '2019-02-29') .filterBounds(desert) .select('Optical_Depth_047'); const size2020 = col2020.size().getInfo(); const size2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); print(`Feb 2020 Images: ${size2020}, Feb 2019 Images: ${size2019}`); if (size2020 === 0 || size2019 === 0) { print("Insufficient data for one or both years."); print("C1"); return; } // Compute mean AOD for each period const mean2020 = col2020.mean().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: desert, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Optical_Depth_047').getInfo(); const mean2019 = col2019.mean().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: desert, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Optical_Depth_047').getInfo(); print(`Feb 2020 AOD: ${(mean2020 || 0).toFixed(3)}`); print(`Feb 2019 AOD: ${(mean2019 || 0).toFixed(3)}`); if (mean2020 === null || mean2019 === null || isNaN(mean2020) || isNaN(mean2019)) { print("C3"); return; } if (mean2020 > mean2019) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
